name: web_fetch_vercel_url
description: Fetch a Vercel deployment URL that the user's Vercel account can access, including deployments protected by Vercel Authentication, and return the response. To do so, it creates or reuses a temporary share link on the deployment (new links expire in 23 hours). Follows same-origin redirects only; a redirect to another origin is returned without being followed.

url.description: The full URL of the Vercel deployment including the path (e.g. "https://myapp.vercel.app/my-page").
